tagline: 柯尼卡便携相机，1986 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1986年推出的便携相机。配备Konica 35 mm, f/2.8 (Tessar-style 4 elements in 3 groups).。快门速度1/4–1/500 s.。使用Motorwind.。Autofocus, 1 m to infinity. Focus lock.。

specs.镜头: Konica 35 mm, f/2.8 (Tessar-style 4 elements in 3 groups).
specs.对焦: Autofocus, 1 m to infinity. Focus lock.
specs.取景器: Contains several framelines for parallax reminders at a range of distances. Zone symbols for head shot, group and infinity (mountains) appear in viewfinder. Focus lock available.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, manually activated. Low-light LED warning.
specs.英文简介: The top of the MT (Multi) range of compact cameras from Konica, the MT-11 featured the fastest lens of the series, as well as a closeup mode, focusing down to 0,45 m.
